findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "explain_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pour, pass_the_round · Private data: pour, menu, pete_site, play_jukebox, restraint_test, check_the_door, secret_menu, whats_playing · Public sink: pour, show_id, secret_menu · Destructive: pour, restraint_test, breathalyzer, secret_menu.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pour, pass_the_round · Private data: pour, menu, pete_site, play_jukebox, restraint_test, check_the_door, secret_menu, whats_playing · Public sink: pour, show_id, secret_menu · Destructive: pour, restraint_test, breathalyzer, secret_menu

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
